bot_config {"Rand": 1}
join hortbot 999 foobar 1

# Floats

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_RANDOM_1_10_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 6.4
